attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page gives no year of birth and no year of death — «απεβίωσε ειρηνικά» and nothing more — so no `dates` object is drafted. It places him among the ascetics of the Egyptian desert and names no settlement, so no coordinate is proposed. It prints no hymn. Its only narrative is the passage Nicodemus the Hagiorite wrote about him in his Synaxaristes out of the Evergetinos, which the life summarises; the Abba Abraham who appears in that passage is not identified further by the page and no `related` row is made for him.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
